_meta.title: 2 Samuel — key verses (King James Version, public domain)
_meta.description: Curated key verses from 2 Samuel (God's greatness and David's song: the Lord my rock, God's perfect way). Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.license: Public domain (KJV scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing
_meta.source: getbible.net v2 (KJV, book 10 2 Samuel); verses verbatim, curly apostrophes normalized to straight
_meta.selection: key verses from the substantive chapters; court/battle narrative largely omitted
_meta.renderings: text = the exact KJV verse; plain = original 864zeros plain-English 2026 rendering, faithful to the verse's meaning (~grade 6-8), authored not quoted.
_meta.note: getbible's KJV renders the divine name as 'the Lord'; text is verbatim KJV. No review gate — author is reviewer.

verses.text: Wherefore thou art great, O Lord God: for there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.plain: How great you are, Sovereign Lord! There is no one like you, and there is no God but you, as we have heard with our own ears.
verses.visual_prompt: an earthenware water pitcher resting on a rough stone bench in a quiet rooftop parapet overlooking Jerusalem

verses.text: And he said, The Lord is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;
verses.plain: He said: The Lord is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer;
verses.visual_prompt: a massive overhanging crag of weathered limestone sheltering a quiet mountain trail in the steep dry-stone terraces of Mount Zion

verses.text: As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the Lord is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him.
verses.plain: As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the Lord is flawless; he is a shield to all who take refuge in him.
verses.visual_prompt: a massive overhanging crag of weathered rock sheltering a quiet mountain path
